title: ipomoea littoralis
intro: Ipomoea littoralis, commonly known as Beach Morning Glory, is a species of flowering plant in the morning glory family. It has been used for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Beach Morning Glory include its ability to act as a sedative and anxiolytic, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
